properties.description: pre-reaction pi-complex of cyclopentadiene and maleic anhydride (one dot-joined complex node; the two fragments are separate molecules, closest heavy-atom contact ~3.1 A). B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP, SMD(benzene), 0 imaginary frequencies (lowest mode 14.2 cm-1).
properties.conformers: jobs/rc_exo.log is a second, higher-lying conformer of the same complex (exo-oriented stacking, E = -573.029711344 Ha, i.e. +1.08 kcal/mol); it is not a distinct barrier reference. Both channel barriers are referred to the lowest complex minimum (jobs/rc_endo.log, -573.031426948 Ha), as the barrier rule requires.

properties.description: concerted [4+2] transition state of the endo channel: the anhydride ring is folded toward the diene/alkene bridge (secondary orbital overlap). Forming C-C distances 2.20 A; exactly one imaginary frequency -408.3 cm-1; IRC (LQA) converged in both directions and its outer frames optimize to the declared pi-complex and the declared endo adduct.
properties.irc_status: converged both directions (87 points, normal termination); outer frames optimized+freq-checked: reactant slot -573.031426923 (0 imag) and product slot -573.065947807 (0 imag), matching the declared pi-complex and endo adduct

properties.description: endo-bicyclo[2.2.1]hept-5-ene-2,3-dicarboxylic anhydride (carbic anhydride); meso (Cs), so one SMILES describes the compound. InChIKey from the optimised geometry KNDQHSIWLOJIGP-UMRXKNAASA-N.

concerted [4+2] transition state of the exo channel: the anhydride ring is folded toward the C7 methylene bridge, away from the diene. Forming C-C distances 2.22 A; exactly one imaginary frequency -402.0 cm-1; IRC (LQA) converged in both directions; its complex-side outer frame optimizes to the exo-oriented pi-complex conformer (jobs/rc_exo.log, +1.08 kcal/mol relative to the lowest conformer used as the single barrier reference) and its product-side frame to the exo adduct (jobs/p_exo.log).
properties.irc_status: converged both directions (56 forward / 39 backward points, normal termination); outer frames optimized+freq-checked: complex side -573.029711475 (0 imag, the exo-oriented conformer of the pi-complex) and product side -573.066034930 (0 imag, the exo adduct)

properties.description: exo-bicyclo[2.2.1]hept-5-ene-2,3-dicarboxylic anhydride; meso (Cs), one SMILES. InChIKey from the optimised geometry KNDQHSIWLOJIGP-RNGGSSJXSA-N.

properties.note: atom-map indices of the task: diene C1=C2-C5=C4 (map3 = CH2) and dienophile C11=C12. The two diene pi bonds (1-2, 4-5) and the dienophile pi bond (11-12) become single; the diene central single bond (1-5) becomes the new C=C; two new sigma bonds form (2-11, 4-12). Both stereochemical channels share this pattern.
properties.barrier_definition: dE = E(TS_endo) - E(RC, lowest complex minimum) = -573.014127588 - (-573.031426948) Ha
properties.irc_connection: IRC converged in both directions (ts/ts_0001/jobs/declaration_0003/irc/irc.log, 87 points, normal termination); the two outer frames were optimized and frequency-checked to the pi-complex (declared source) and the endo adduct (declared target).

properties.note: same bond changes as the endo channel; only the stereochemical approach differs
properties.barrier_definition: dE = E(TS_exo) - E(RC, lowest complex minimum) = -573.011307245 - (-573.031426948) Ha
properties.irc_connection: IRC converged in both directions (ts/ts_0002/jobs/declaration_0003/irc/irc.log, 56 forward / 39 backward points, normal termination). Complex-side endpoint = the exo-oriented pi-complex conformer (jobs/rc_exo.log, -573.029711344 Ha); this is a different conformer of the same complex from the single barrier reference jobs/rc_endo.log (-573.031426948 Ha), which is allowed: the barrier rule asks for the lowest verified minimum including connected conformers, while the IRC connection is preserved as computed. Product-side endpoint = the exo adduct (jobs/p_exo.log).
